calculators.title_native: Løn Efter Skat Calculator - Brutto til Netto Løn (Danmark)
calculators.description_native: Beregn din netto løn efter AM-bidrag (8%), A-skat, kommuneskat, bundskat, topskat, beskæftigelsesfradrag og personfradrag i Danmark.
calculators.formula_explanation: Gross Salary (Bruttoløn) - Employee Pension - ATP (standard 99 DKK/month) = Pre-AM Base. Labor Market Contribution (AM-bidrag) = 8% * Pre-AM Base. Taxable Salary Base (Skattepligtig indkomst) = Pre-AM Base - AM-bidrag. Tax Deductions (Skattefradrag) = Personfradrag (DKK 49,700/year = DKK 4,141.67/month) + Beskæftigelsesfradrag (10.65% up to DKK 45,100/year) + Befordringsfradrag (commuter deduction for km > 24) + Union/A-kasse deduction (up to DKK 7,000/year). Net Taxable Amount = Taxable Base - Deductions. Progressive Tax Rates applied: Municipal tax (Kommuneskat ~24.5%) + Church Tax (~0.7% if member) + State Bottom Tax (Bundskat 12.01%) + State Top Tax (Topskat 15% on income above DKK 588,900/year after AM-bidrag) + Top-Topskat (5% on income above DKK 2,588,900/year). Total A-skat = Net Taxable Amount * Effective Tax Rate (Trækprocent). Net Salary (Udbetalt løn) = Gross Salary - Employee Pension - ATP - AM-bidrag - A-skat.

calculators.title_en: Denmark Sole Proprietorship vs. ApS Company Tax & Salary Optimizer
calculators.description_native: Sammenlign nettoudbytte og skat mellem enkeltmandsvirksomhed (personlig beskatning / VSO) og anpartsselskab (ApS) med direktørløn og dividender.

inputs.name: planned_director_salary_monthly
inputs.label_native: Planlagt direktørløn om måneden i ApS (DKK)

inputs.name: retained_earnings_percent
inputs.label_native: Andel af overskud der opspares i virksomheden (%)

calculators.formula_explanation: Business Profit = Annual Revenue - Operating Expenses. Option A: Enkeltmandsvirksomhed (Standard): 100% of profit taxed as personal income (AM-bidrag 8% + A-skat personal rates up to ~52%). Option B: Enkeltmandsvirksomhed with VSO (Virksomhedsskatteordningen): Profit withdrawn for personal use taxed as personal income; retained profit taxed provisionally at 22% corporate tax rate (Virksomhedsskat). Option C: ApS (Anpartsselskab): Director Salary is deducted as business expense. Remaining Corporate Profit taxed at 22% Selskabsskat. Retained profit stays in ApS equity. Profit paid out as Dividend (Udbytte) taxed at Udbytteskat rates: 27% on dividends up to DKK 61,000 (DKK 122,000 for married couples), and 42% on dividend amounts exceeding threshold. Director Salary taxed with 8% AM-bidrag + personal A-skat. Optimizer computes total net payout to owner across all three options.

calculators.title_en: Denmark Real Estate Purchase Tax, Deed Registration & Monthly Housing Expense Calculator
calculators.description_native: Beregn tinglysningsafgift for skøde og realkreditlån, boligadvokat, ejendomsværdiskat, grundskyld og samlede månedlige ejerudgifter ved boligkøb i Danmark.
calculators.formula_explanation: 1. Deed Registration Fee (Tinglysningsafgift for skøde): DKK 1,850 fixed fee + 0.6% of the highest of Purchase Price or Public Valuation. 2. Mortgage Deed Registration Fee (Tinglysning af realkreditpantebrev): DKK 1,825 fixed fee + 1.45% of total mortgage loan principal. 3. Bank Loan Deed Registration (if separate pantebrev): DKK 1,825 + 1.45% of bank loan. 4. Annual Property Value Tax (Ejendomsværdiskat): 0.51% on valuation up to DKK 9.2 million + 1.4% on portion exceeding DKK 9.2 million (with modern tax rabat rule applied). 5. Annual Land Tax (Grundskyld): Land Value * (Grundskyldspromille / 1000). Total One-Off Closing Costs = Deed Tax + Loan Registration Tax + Lawyer Fee + Bank Setup Fees. Total Monthly Housing Cost = Realkredit Payment + Bank Loan Payment + (Ejendomsværdiskat + Grundskyld)/12 + Monthly Common Expenses (Ejerudgift).

calculators.title_en: Denmark Commuter Tax Deduction & Tax-Free Mileage Allowance Calculator
calculators.description_native: Beregn dit årlige befordringsfradrag (kørselsfradrag på årsopgørelsen) eller din skattefri kørselsgodtgørelse efter Statens takster.

inputs.name: annual_working_days
inputs.label_native: Antal arbejdsdage med transport om året

inputs.name: calculation_mode
options: Befordringsfradrag (Egen bil/offentlig transport - Fradrag i skat)

inputs.name: bridge_toll_crossings
inputs.label_native: Antal passager af Storebælt / Øresund om året

calculators.formula_explanation: Mode 1: Befordringsfradrag (Commuter Tax Deduction): First 24 km/day = 0 DKK deduction. Distance between 25 km and 120 km = Daily km * DKK 2.23 (2025/2026 statutory rate). Distance above 120 km = Daily km * DKK 1.12 (Standard rate) OR DKK 2.23 if residing in designated yderkommune/ø-kommune. Total Annual Deduction = (Daily Deduction Rate * Working Days) + Bridge Toll Allowance (Storebælt: DKK 110/trip by train/car, Øresund DKK 50/trip). Net Tax Value (Skatteværdi af fradrag) = Total Annual Deduction * ~26% (Municipal tax value). Mode 2: Skattefri Kørselsgodtgørelse (Statens Takster paid by employer): Up to 20,000 km/year = km * DKK 3.79/km. Above 20,000 km/year = km * DKK 2.23/km. Total payout is 100% tax-free income directly from employer.

calculators.title_native: B-Indkomst & Moms Beregner for Freelancere & Honorarmodtagere
calculators.title_en: Denmark Freelance B-Income Tax & VAT (Moms) Calculator
calculators.description_native: Beregn A-skat, AM-bidrag, B-skat rater og salgsmoms/købsmoms for freelance honorarer, B-indkomst og mindre virksomhed uden A-skat.

inputs.name: annual_gross_b_income
inputs.label_native: Forventet årlig B-indkomst / honorarer excl. moms (DKK)

calculators.formula_explanation: 1. Sales VAT (Salgsmoms) = Gross B-Income * 25% (if VAT registered). 2. Purchase VAT (Købsmoms) = Expenses * 25%. Net VAT Payable to SKAT = Salgsmoms - Købsmoms. 3. Net Taxable B-Income (Netto B-indkomst) = Gross B-Income - Deductible Business Expenses. 4. AM-bidrag (Labor Market Contribution) = 8% of Net Taxable B-Income. 5. Tax Base for B-skat = Net Taxable B-Income - AM-bidrag - Unused Personfradrag. 6. B-skat = Tax Base * (Municipal Tax % + State Tax Rates). Total Annual Tax Liability = AM-bidrag + B-skat. 7. B-Skat Installments: Divide total B-skat into 10 annual installments (B-skatterater payable in Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov). Net Take-Home Income = Gross B-Income - Expenses - AM-bidrag - B-skat.
